curriculumRows.standard: 6.NS.1: Interpret and compute quotients of fractions, and solve word problems involving division of fractions by fractions, e.g., by using visual fraction models and equations to represent the problem.
curriculumRows.contentVocab: Quotient- The result or answer obtained by dividing one number by another. Fraction- A number that represents a part of a whole or a division of two quantities, expressed in the form a/b (where b 0). Equation- A mathematical statement containing an equals sign (=) that shows two expressions have the exact same value. Interpret- To explain or understand the mathematical meaning of a value, model, equation, or visual representation within a given context. Compute- To calculate or work out a numerical value using mathematical processes or algorithms. Solve- To find the value or set of values that makes an equation, inequality, or open mathematical statement true. Involve- To require or include specific concepts, operations, or steps as part of a mathematical problem or procedure. Use- To apply a rule, formula, strategy, tool, or mathematical concept to solve a problem or represent a situation. Represent- To express a mathematical relationship, quantity, or concept using symbols, diagrams, tables, graphs, or equations.
curriculumRows.targetOrder: I can define quotients, fractions, and division when dividing fractions. I can explain what a fraction division quotient means in a real-world context and interpret visual fraction models. I can compute quotients of fractions and draw visual fraction models to represent division problems. I can create visual fraction models or write equations to represent and solve fraction division word problems. I can fluently divide multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.

curriculumRows.standard: 6.NS.2: Fluently divide multi-digit numbers using the standard algorithm.
curriculumRows.contentVocab: Algorithm- A set of step-by-step procedures or rules followed in calculations or problem-solving operations.
curriculumRows.targetOrder: I can recall the steps and place-value rules of the standard division algorithm. I can estimate quotients to determine if my multi-digit division answer is reasonable.

curriculumRows.standard: 6.NS.3: Fluently add, subtract, multiply, and divide multi-digit decimals using the standard algorithm for each operation.
curriculumRows.contentVocab: Decimal- A number in the base-10 positional numeral system containing a decimal point to separate the whole number part from the fractional part. Operation- A mathematical action or process performed on one or more values to produce a new value (such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division).
